data.notes: As of this research pass, July 2027 has one fully confirmed travel-scale music event in Split itself; most local club nights and smaller summer festivals have not yet published 2027 dates.

events.title: Ultra Europe 2027
events.summary: Ultra Europe is confirmed for Friday, July 9 through Sunday, July 11, 2027 at Park Mladeži in Split. The official ticket page lists the 2027 dates and confirms three-day festival passes for the electronic festival.

events.title: Yacht Week: Ultra, Croatia
events.summary: A week-long Yacht Week route built around Split’s Ultra weekend, combining yacht parties, floating DJ-deck raft events, Carpe Diem beach-party energy and VIP festival access, with EDM, house and techno across the programme.

events.title: Cruizin’ Croatia 2027 — Rum & Music Events x Yacht Week
events.summary: A Caribbean-diaspora Yacht Week takeover listed for Split, bringing Rum & Music’s fete culture to Croatia with soca, dancehall, reggae, afrobeats, amapiano, hip-hop and R&B across yacht, raft-up, day-club and island-party formats.

events.title: Sails N’ Beats 2027
events.summary: A boutique yacht-and-music week starting in Split, built around international DJs, onboard sound-and-light setups, sunset sessions, yacht parties and beach-club/island nights along the Croatian coast.
